name: agent-ks
description: Teaches an AI agent to operate an agent-knowledge-system project. It covers docs and blog posts, the folder-per-issue tracker (plans, subtasks, agent logs, agent memory), and self-contained HTML artifacts. Every command is a skill folder, so Claude Code and Codex both read it. Ships ten skills, three of them commands (config, quick-idea-note, index-check), a read-only index-checking agent, and instructions for the standalone `agent-ks` CLI. Install the standalone agent-ks Rust toolkit separately from GitHub Releases.
